summary: Tested P3 'Red Team Drill Mode' for MOD sites. All 19 backend tests pass. Frontend UI verified: Admin MOD Console shows Drill column with Start/Complete buttons, drill launcher modal opens with default scenario, MOD Site Dashboard shows DrillBanner with scenario text, ticket ref, and Acknowledge button. KPI exclusion verified: admin open_faults count excludes drills (RAF shows 3, not 4 when drill active).
seed_data_creation: Test drills created and completed during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: P3 Red Team Drill Mode fully tested. Key findings: (1) POST /api/master-admin/mod/sites/{site_id}/drill/start creates drill with is_drill=True, priority=urgent, status=open, ticket_ref matching DRILL-YYYY-NNNNN pattern, (2) GET /api/mod/site/drills/active returns active drill for site users (403 for admin/branch/org), (3) POST /api/mod/site/drills/{drill_id}/acknowledge sets drill_acknowledged_at, returns already_acknowledged=True on second call, cross-site returns 404, (4) POST /api/master-admin/mod/drills/{drill_id}/complete returns report with time_to_acknowledge_s, time_to_resolve_s, attachments_captured, (5) GET /api/master-admin/mod/drills lists all drills sorted by drill_started_at desc with site_name and site_branch, (6) KPI exclusion verified: admin open_faults excludes drills, PRO dashboard open_urgent and recent_urgent exclude drills, (7) Frontend Admin MOD Console shows Drill column with data-testid='admin-mod-drill-start-{site_id}' and 'admin-mod-drill-complete-{site_id}', drill launcher modal has scenario input with default 'Unplanned power loss on cardio bank', (8) Frontend MOD Site Dashboard shows DrillBanner with data-testid='mod-drill-banner' when active drill exists, includes scenario, ticket ref, and Acknowledge button.

backend_api: POST /api/master-admin/mod/sites/{site_id}/drill/start returns 200 with ok, drill_id, issue_id, ticket_ref
Invalid site_id returns 404 on drill start
GET /api/master-admin/mod/sites excludes drills from open_faults count
GET /api/mod/pro/dashboard excludes drills from open_urgent and recent_urgent
GET /api/mod/site/drills/active returns drill for site user
GET /api/master-admin/mod/drills lists all drills sorted by drill_started_at desc
Drill with safe_in_service='no' does NOT flip equipment to out_of_service
frontend_ui: Admin MOD Console loads with data-testid='admin-mod-console'
Drill column renders with Start buttons (data-testid='admin-mod-drill-start-{site_id}')
Drill column renders with Complete buttons for active drills (data-testid='admin-mod-drill-complete-{site_id}')
Drill launcher modal opens with data-testid='admin-mod-drill-launcher'
Scenario input has default value 'Unplanned power loss on cardio bank'
Start drill confirm button renders with data-testid='admin-mod-drill-start-confirm'
MOD Site Dashboard loads with data-testid='mod-site-dashboard'
DrillBanner renders with data-testid='mod-drill-banner' when active drill exists
DrillBanner shows scenario text and ticket ref
Acknowledge drill button renders with data-testid='mod-drill-acknowledge'
Log Fault button renders with data-testid='mod-log-fault-btn'
